name: orb-duel-review
description: Independent, read-only review of the Cowboys vs. Wizards Chrome replay receipt against the current built page, plus Showdown seat play and engine-bound Showdown proof replay, a check of the evidence behind Showdown Outrider ride decisions (why take or decline a ride past enemy troops), and a rerun check of a recorded card proposal review (one card spec stat change measured by the Showdown smoke sample), and a Replay Room coaching lesson that reveals the two recorded outcomes after a target is chosen.
